_help.about: Gear, rarities, affixes and pickups. Weapons live in weapons.json. Array entries with "disabled": true are skipped.
_help.rarities: Blessing rarities: exactly four tiers, lowest first (common, rare, epic, legendary), used by blessings and the workbench shop. Gear uses itemRarities instead.
_help.rarities.weight: Base chance weight when rolling a rarity (blessings and items alike).
_help.rarities.luckFactor: How luck changes the weight: weight x (1 + luck/100 x factor). Negative values divide instead, so luck makes that tier rarer.
_help.scaling: weaponRoll: how far each end of a weapon's damage range may move from weapons.json (0.07 = +/-7%, never past 0.7x-1.3x of the middle). affixRoll: random spread of modifier values (0.15 = +/-15%). armorRoll is in armor.
_help.slots: The five equipment slots are fixed (weapon, hat, body, boots, charm). You can rename them and change how often each drops.
_help.gear: Base items per slot. Models: hat = straw, cap, cowboy, antenna, dome, shamanmask, bearhood, flayedhood or tentaclecrown. body = body, tiki, bearpelt, butcherapron or voidmantle. boots = boots, moonboots, bearpaws, bloodboots or voidtreads. charm = horseshoe, bell, watch, heartjar or voideye. color tints body and boots. tag = alien, spirit or eldritch: themed gear that only drops on maps listing the tag in their "gear" (stages.json; "alien": true works too). stats = the base item's own stats, on every copy (grow with item level when the stat is listed in itemLevel.scaling). set = a set id from sets.
_help.sets: Gear sets: wear several pieces of one set for its bonuses. bonuses = { pieces worn: stats }; every bonus up to the pieces you wear applies.
_help.affixes: Modifiers. base = the value at item level 1 on a Common item (x the rarity's affixPower, x item level for stats in itemLevel.scaling, +/- affixRoll). weight = how often it rolls (1 = common, 0.35 = uncommon). slots = where it can roll. weaponClass = on weapons it only rolls on that class (melee, firearm or magic); on other slots it rolls freely. alienOnly: true = only on alien gear and alien weapons. Stat keys are listed in characters.json. Weapons roll their own lines: wDmg (increased damage of this weapon only), wSpeed (attack speed of this weapon only), wCrit (increased base crit of this weapon only), flatElem (flat elemental damage added to every hit).
_help.pickups: fishHeal = share of max health a fish restores. catnipBuff = buff id from status_effects.json given by catnip ("" for none). despawnSeconds = how long fish and catnip stay on the ground.
_help.itemLevel: Item level: items drop at item levels 1-10 on the first map, 11-20 on the second, and so on (stages.json maps[].itemLevel), rising as the day goes on; the workbench can raise an item's level by up to 3 for essence (stages.json camp.upgrade). Item level multiplies every stat the item has. Stats in scaling (and weapon damage) grow by (1 + perLevel) per level, compounding: with 0.15, level 10 is about x3.5, level 20 x14 and level 30 x58. Every other stat (chances, speeds, luck...) grows by otherPerLevel per level, added up: with 0.08, level 10 is x1.72 and level 30 x3.32. Whole-number stats in steps (projectiles, ricochet bounces) instead gain their base once more every stepEvery levels (+1 at 1-10, +2 at 11-20, ...).
_help.itemRarities: Gear rarities, lowest first: Common (no modifiers), Magic (two) and Rare (three). weight / luckFactor: as for blessings. affixes: modifiers rolled. weaponDamage: weapon damage multiplier. affixPower: modifier value multiplier. scrapXp: experience for scrapping one (grows with item level). prefixes: random name prefixes, e.g. Rusty Scythe.
_help.armor: Every item except weapons rolls armor between [min, max] for its slot at item level 1 (it grows with item level). Weapons have block rating instead (weapons.json block). Armor turns into damage reduction: armor / (armor + 100), at most maxReduction.
